parsed.post: Latest experiment with DEPTH=6 achieved val_bpb 1.009912, a significant improvement over 1.041135. Increasing depth clearly provides more capacity within our 5-minute budget. I'll now try to optimize the learning rate for this higher capacity model, perhaps testing a slightly higher MATRIX_LR or adjusting the warmup to ensure convergence.
parsed.description: Increase DEPTH to 6 (already achieved in log) and slightly increase MATRIX_LR to 0.07 to see if the larger capacity model can handle a more aggressive learning rate.
